regionwatch.mode.change: When it differs from the reference
regionwatch.hint.idle: Start screen sharing and the screen appears here. Drag on it to pick a region.
regionwatch.hint.pick: Drag on the preview to choose the spot to watch.
regionwatch.hint.running: Press Pick region on a slot, then drag on the preview. The reference look is saved the moment you pick.
regionwatch.status.idle: Starting screen share makes the browser ask which screen to show. Frames are compared inside this tab only and never sent anywhere.
regionwatch.say.running: Watching. It keeps watching while the tab is in the background.
regionwatch.notify.title: Screen region watch
regionwatch.warn.size: Saved regions were picked on a {a} screen but this screen is {b}. Pick the regions again.
regionwatch.err.unsupported: This browser does not support screen sharing. Try Chrome or Edge.
regionwatch.err.pip: Could not open the floating window.
regionwatch.label.name: Slot name
regionwatch.mode.count: When seconds left drop to N
regionwatch.hint.count: Seconds-left mode reads only the digits in that region. Pick tightly around the number.
regionwatch.label.profile: Profile for {size} screen. {n} screen sizes saved
regionwatch.say.segment: Started a new segment for {name}. Start value {value}.
regionwatch.hint.trend: Trend log reads the number in the region every second. Pick tightly around the number.
regionwatch.hint.hotkey: Shortcuts: Alt+Shift+S start/stop, Alt+Shift+P floating window (while this tab is in front)
regionwatch.say.soundsSaved: Saved {n} custom sounds. Pick them in a slot's sound.
